model: Power Xpert Meter 2000 - analog output (4-20 mA / 0-1 mA) card (virtual device)
applies_to: Eaton PXM 2000 meters fitted with the optional 4-channel analog output card.
summary: The optional analog output card shows up as its own virtual BACnet IP device. Its objects show which meter value drives each of the four outputs and the low / high scaling values; the analog outputs themselves are not BACnet objects.
notes: From IB150011EN Table 3 (AO 4-20 or 0-1 card). The card device object is not repeated in the points list; the doc prints no instance for it.
Object names carry the card path prefix /01/01/ as printed.
The booklet gives no units or access columns; all objects are listed as read-only.

source.title: BACnet object list for Power Xpert Meter 2000

integration.summary: Discover the card virtual device alongside the meter data device over BACnet IP and read its I/O states and counters.
setup: Each option card appears as a separate virtual BACnet device next to the meter data device.
gotchas: Object instances repeat across the meter and card devices; map them per device.
